Definition: properly, voluntary, i.e. generous; hence, magnanimous; as noun, a grandee (sometimes a tyrant)
BiblicalUsage: adj; 1) inclined, willing, noble, generous; 1a) incited, inclined, willing; 1b) noble, princely (in rank); 1c) noble (in mind and character); n m; 2) noble one
